name: 英国成长型企业工作签证
summary: 面向获得获批英国成长型企业至少六个月担保工作、且满足职业、工资和英语要求的人士。
summaryEn: For people offered at least six months of sponsored work by an approved UK scale-up business who meet the occupation, salary and English requirements.

jobOffer.summary: 初次申请须有获批成长型企业提供的工作邀请，担保岗位至少持续六个月。
jobOffer.summaryEn: A first application requires a job offer from an approved scale-up business for at least six months of sponsored work.

sponsorship.summary: 雇主须获英国内政部批准作为成长型企业路线担保人，并签发担保证明。
sponsorship.summaryEn: The employer must be Home Office-approved for the Scale-up route and issue a certificate of sponsorship.

occupation.summary: 岗位四位职业代码须列为该签证的合资格职业。
occupation.summaryEn: The job's four-digit occupation code must be eligible for this visa.

salary.summary: 工资须达到现行一般门槛与该职业现行工资两者中的较高者；延期规则可能不同。
salary.summaryEn: Pay must reach the higher of the current general threshold and the occupation's going rate; extension rules may differ.

english.summary: 通常须以认可方式证明英语能力；首次申请现行标准为 CEFR B2，豁免或既往证明规则可能适用。
english.summaryEn: English normally must be proved through an accepted route; the current standard for a first application is CEFR B2, subject to exemptions or previous proof.

sources.title: Scale-up Worker visa — Knowledge of English

disclaimer: 本资料仅供一般教育用途，不构成个性化移民或法律建议。
